description: Module D meta-schema (amended 2026-11-20, issue #275 continuation): the structural legality rules every per-repository ontology model instance must satisfy. The skill owns THIS file — the meta layer; each repository instantiates its own model (instance layer) with its own entity types and vocabulary. validate_ontology_model.py reads this file as the single source of the required-field contract; hard-coding the contract a second time is the drift this design removes.

entity.notes: an entity is a type of thing the docs system talks about, declared with the one bounded question it answers

attribute.notes: an attribute belongs to exactly one entity (owner references an entity id); an entity may declare its attribute ids

relation.notes: a typed edge between two entities; type vocabulary is the instance's own (declared per repository)

rule.notes: a rule the docs system asserts; traces are repo-relative page paths the rule derives from — a rule with no trace is an unsourced claim

page_receipt.notes: per-page decomposition receipt: the model elements (entity/attribute/relation/rule ids) the page's content decomposes into; every referenced id must exist

coverage.invariant: every page covered by the repository's doc map must appear in pages[]
coverage.diagnostic: CONTENT_UNCOVERED (signal — declare the receipt; never delete the page on this signal)

anchor_mirror.invariant: when a page declares a model-elements anchor, it must match the receipt's elements exactly (both directions, order-insensitive); the receipt is the source of truth
anchor_mirror.diagnostic: ANCHOR_RECEIPT_DRIFT (signal — fix the mirror; missing anchors are tolerated as receipts may precede anchor rollout)
anchor_mirror.two_way_guard: silent anchor deletion is guarded in the consuming repository's root regression suite, which observes the anchors as public pages
